item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00279","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C07","C10","C20"],"selected_candidate_label":"C07","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C07 plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting foundation. It establishes the precise Atomic Energy Act machinery invoked by the child: cooperation agreements under sections 144(a)–(c), presidential or joint Atomic Energy Commission–Department of Defense determinations concerning communicable Restricted Data, and implementation subject to the agreement involved. The child expressly incorporates a joint determination made pursuant to the masked directive reference, strongly indicating direct reliance on C07 rather than merely a common subject. C10 and C20 contain related language authorizing an agency, with Atomic Energy Commission participation, to communicate Restricted Data under a cooperation agreement, but they are letters addressing particular agreements and are less structurally aligned with the child's general administrative authorization.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"in accordance with the terms and conditions of any agreement for cooperation arranged pursuant to subsections 144 a, b, or c of the Act","parent_excerpt":"a proposed agreement providing for cooperation pursuant to section 91c, 144a, 144b, or 144c of the Act","explanation":"Both provisions organize the authority around the same enumerated statutory agreement-for-cooperation framework."},{"child_excerpt":"as is determined (i) by the President ... or (ii) by the Atomic Energy Commission and the Department of Defense, jointly pursuant to the provisions of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], to be transmissible","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of Defense and the Atomic Energy Commission are hereby designated and empowered to exercise jointly ... [the authority] to determine that the proposed cooperation and the proposed communication of Restricted Data ... will promote and will not constitute an unreasonable risk","explanation":"The child directly relies on the parent's distinctive joint-determination mechanism for deciding what Restricted Data may be communicated."},{"child_excerpt":"Such communications shall be effected ... in accordance with the terms and conditions of the agreement for cooperation involved","parent_excerpt":"such approval and authorization by the President shall constitute his authorization to cooperate to the extent provided for in the agreement","explanation":"Both tie the scope and manner of authorized cooperation or communication to the governing agreement."}]}
